public.text: Supplier identity may already be governed by national business, tax, procurement, customs, or legal-entity registries. A separate health Supplier Registry could duplicate foundational data.
public.suggestedRevision: Define it as a health-sector qualification and reference layer built on authoritative cross-sector organisation and supplier identities where available.
